title: Video Stitch Tool
description: Request for video_stitch: clip validation, multi-clip assembly with transitions, and spatial layouts. The same contract `facet tools describe video_stitch` publishes.

operation.description: validate compares clip properties; stitch joins clips; preview_stitch joins them fast at 640x360; spatial composes two clips into one frame

clips.description: Input video file paths, in playback order

output_path.description: Path for the output video file

transition.description: Transition between clips. 'cut' = hard cut, 'crossfade' = blend between clips, 'fade' = fade through black

auto_normalize.description: Accepted for compatibility. stitch and preview_stitch always normalize every clip to one size, frame rate and audio format.

target_resolution.description: stitch only: output size such as 1920x1080. Defaults to the first clip's size.

target_fps.description: stitch only: output frame rate. Defaults to the first clip's rate.

crf.description: Constant Rate Factor for quality (lower = better)

pip_scale.description: Scale of the picture-in-picture overlay relative to the base video

pip_margin.description: Margin in pixels between the picture-in-picture overlay and the frame edges

timeout_seconds.description: Time allowed for the whole operation
